cells.gaps: No commencement notice is held; the minister's statement of May 2026 that the law is in place (GMB-019) is read as in force. Oversight is assigned to the Access to Information Authority's commissioners, still being trained in May 2026 (GMB-020), so the authority is provided, not shown acting. No decision, sanction or count under the Act is on record.
cells.note: The 2025 Act is in force by the minister's account of May 2026 (GMB-019), which is stage 3, and no decision under it is on record, so stage 4 is not met. Stage 3 is not capped, so the authority's standing does not change it.
